name: weight-estimator
notes: Bbox-area regression. Placeholder slope/intercept of 0 means it'll output 0g until you calibrate. To calibrate: catch ~30 chickens across the age range, weigh them, snap the camera frame at catch-time, and fit sklearn LinearRegression on (normalized_bbox_area, weight_g) pairs. Paste the resulting slope + intercept here. Per-camera ref_area_px can be the median bbox area of a known-weight chicken in that camera, used to normalize across cameras with different mount heights.
